description:
C-5 Nose Landing Gear (NLG) Door Actuators Assemblies
LH Actuator Assembly: NSN: 1680-01-160-6520UC  PN: 177560-32
RH Actuator Assembly: NSN: 1680-01-160-6519UC  PN: 177560-33
LH Actuator Assembly:  NSN: 1680-01-237-0231UC  PN: 177560-34
RH Actuator Assembly: NSN: 1680-01-237-0230UC   PN: 177560-35

These actuator assemblies are part of the C-5 NLG Door Actuation System. The NLG doors consist of two inboard doors and two outboard doors and are actuated separately from the gear. When the NLG is extended, the doors are held open by the actuators, and when the landing gear is retracted, the actuators close the doors to enclose the landing gear and streamline the aircraft. 

This overhaul effort will utilize a Requirements Type Contract. Contract period of performance will be five (5) years. It will consist of a one (1) year basic period and four (4) one (1) year ordering periods. The Best Estimated Quantities for each ordering period are listed below. The USAF anticipates the acquisition will be Full and Open Competition utilizing the Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA).

It is anticipated that the RFP will be released in May 2026. The RFP will be posted to the SAM webpage. NO HARDCOPIES WILL BE PROVIDED. The technical data required to respond to the RFP may be obtained at the same website. All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. Offerors are encouraged to register on the site to receive notifications regarding the solicitation and all amendments/revisions.

One or more of the items under this acquisition is subject to the Buy American Act.
